raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Fixes https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/62123.

`POST /pause?mode=keep` is documented to ignore `clear_cache` ("Ignored when
mode=keep"), but `AsyncLLM.pause_generation` cleared the frontend multimodal
cache and forwarded `clear_cache=True` to the engine for every mode. With
`--mm-processor-cache-type shm`, that resets the writer-side ring buffer while
requests frozen in the queue still hold `(address, monotonic_id)` handles into
it. When such a request is scheduled after `/resume`, the worker's handle
validation raises `ValueError: Data for address:id ... has been modified or is
invalid.` inside `execute_model`, which kills EngineCore (`EngineDeadError`):
every in-flight and later request fails and `/health` stops answering 200.

The fix makes `pause_generation` honor the documented semantics: when
`mode="keep"`, `clear_cache` is forced to `False` so neither the frontend MM
cache nor the engine-side caches are touched. `abort`/`wait` behavior is
unchanged.

## Test commands and results

New regression tests in `tests/v1/engine/test_llm_engine.py` (mocked
renderer/engine core, no GPU needed):

- `test_pause_generation_keep_ignores_clear_cache` — `mode="keep"` with
  `clear_cache=True` clears nothing and forwards `clear_cache=False`
- `test_pause_generation_abort_honors_clear_cache` — `abort` still clears
- `test_pause_generation_wait_honors_clear_cache` — `wait` still honors
  explicit `clear_cache=True`

The fix logic was additionally verified by executing the method source
extracted verbatim from `vllm/v1/engine/async_llm.py` against mocked
renderer/engine-core objects; all four mode/flag combinations behave as
documented (keep never clears; abort/wait honor the flag).

Full server-level reproduction from the issue (Qwen2-VL on GPU) was not
re-runnable in this environment (no GPU); the change is confined to the pause
request path and does not touch model execution, sampling, or any model
output, so no model evaluation results are applicable.

`pre-commit` hooks pass on the change; DCO sign-off included.

## Why this is not duplicating an existing PR

Checked before opening: the issue has no linked fix PRs in its timeline, no
assignee, and no claim comments besides the author's own. Searched open PRs in
`vllm-project/vllm` for `pause shm cache`, `"mode=keep"`, and
`"reset_mm_cache"` — the only related hit is #57970, a docs-only PR clarifying
keep-mode pause semantics, which does not change behavior.

## AI assistance disclosure

This PR was prepared with AI assistance (Muse). The change was reviewed line
by line, the fix area and its edge cases were verified as described above, and
a human submitter understands and defends the change end-to-end.

---

Thank you to @Yunzez for the thorough report, reproducer, and root-cause
analysis.

nodes.body:
Hi @njhill — thank you for your time. A friendly follow-up on this PR: it fixes pause mode=keep clearing the cache when it should be kept (the issue in #62123), with a regression test in tests/v1/engine/test_llm_engine.py.

The PR is still mergeable, the DCO check is green, and the only outstanding gate is the usual pre-run-check label gate for external contributors. Whenever you have a moment, I would appreciate a review — and please let me know if anything else is needed. Thank you!

Hi @aoshen02, thank you for your work on the pause handling in this area. Just a friendly follow-up on this PR: it makes `pause` with `mode="keep"` ignore `clear_cache`, so the KV cache is preserved instead of being cleared (fixing #62123). The PR is mergeable, DCO is green, and the only pending check is the pre-run-check label gate awaiting a reviewer label. Whenever you have a moment, could you please take a look and let me know if anything needs adjusting? Thank you!

This also removes the reset weight sync relies on. `docs/training/async_rl.md` pauses with `mode="keep", clear_cache=True` and says that clear is why tokens after resume come only from the new weights. From reading, block hashes don't cover the weights and nothing on the update path resets the prefix cache, so with this PR requests after `/resume` would read KV from the old weights with no error. #57970 says the same for `clear_cache=False`: "Tokens generated after resume attend to KV computed with the old weights."

One CPU run on main at `8b30f56b1` (real `AsyncLLM`, `EngineCore` and `Scheduler`, no model or weights, not a server): after a keep pause with the default `clear_cache`, the same 64-token prompt reused 0 tokens from the prefix cache on main and 48 with this PR. A request in flight across the pause was preempted on main and kept its KV with this PR.

The crash in #62123 comes from the multimodal caches, which hold processor output and, from reading, don't depend on the weights. Could keep mode skip only those clears, in the frontend and the engine, and still reset the prefix and encoder caches? A local patch doing that, same run, gave 0 reused tokens and a preempted request, and real SHM caches gave no `ValueError` where main does. puncsky's storage change in #62123 is another option that leaves the KV reset alone. The `Ignored when mode="keep"` docstring looks like the stale part: #60744 says so and #60764 changes it.

[Halo](https://github.com/whitecircle/halo) pauses with `mode=keep` and the default `clear_cache` around each weight sync and counts on this reset. I can share the script and the patch. AI assistance was used for the check and this comment.

files.patch:
@@ -2,13 +2,14 @@
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 import random
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
-from unittest.mock import MagicMock, call
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, call
 
 import pytest
 
 from vllm import LLM
 from vllm.exceptions import ProfilerAlreadyActiveError
 from vllm.sampling_params import SamplingParams, StructuredOutputsParams
+from vllm.v1.engine.async_llm import AsyncLLM
 from vllm.v1.engine.llm_engine import LLMEngine
 from vllm.v1.metrics.reader import Counter, Gauge, Histogram, Metric, Vector
 
@@ -297,3 +298,58 @@ def test_skip_tokenizer_initialization(model: str):
     assert len(completions) > 0
     assert completions[0].text == ""
     assert completions[0].token_ids
+
+
+def _make_pause_test_engine() -> AsyncLLM:
+    engine = object.__new__(AsyncLLM)
+    engine.renderer = MagicMock()
+    engine.renderer.clear_mm_cache_async = AsyncMock()
+    engine.engine_core = MagicMock()
+    engine.engine_core.pause_scheduler_async = AsyncMock()
+    return engine
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pause_generation_keep_ignores_clear_cache():
+    """mode="keep" must not clear any cache.
+
+    Regression test for https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/62123:
+    "keep" freezes requests in the queue, and queued requests may still hold
+    handles into the multimodal cache (e.g. the SHM ring buffer). Clearing it
+    invalidates those handles, which raises ValueError in the worker and
+    kills the engine.
+    """
+    engine = _make_pause_test_engine()
+
+    await engine.pause_generation(mode="keep", clear_cache=True)
+
+    engine.renderer.clear_mm_cache_async.assert_not_called()
+    engine.engine_core.pause_scheduler_async.assert_called_once_with(
+        mode="keep", clear_cache=False
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pause_generation_abort_honors_clear_cache():
+    """mode="abort" still clears caches when clear_cache=True."""
+    engine = _make_pause_test_engine()
+
+    await engine.pause_generation(mode="abort", clear_cache=True)
+
+    engine.renderer.clear_mm_cache_async.assert_awaited_once()
+    engine.engine_core.pause_scheduler_async.assert_called_once_with(
+        mode="abort", clear_cache=True
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pause_generation_wait_honors_clear_cache():
+    """mode="wait" still honors an explicit clear_cache=True."""
+    engine = _make_pause_test_engine()
+
+    await engine.pause_generation(mode="wait", clear_cache=True)
+
+    engine.renderer.clear_mm_cache_async.assert_awaited_once()
+    engine.engine_core.pause_scheduler_async.assert_called_once_with(
+        mode="wait", clear_cache=True
+    )

@@ -995,8 +995,15 @@ async def pause_generation(
                   :meth:`resume_generation`.
             clear_cache: Whether to clear KV cache and prefix cache after
                 draining. Set to ``False`` to preserve cache for faster resume.
+                Ignored when ``mode="keep"``.
 
         """
+        if mode == "keep":
+            # "keep" freezes requests in the queue instead of draining them,
+            # so caches must not be cleared: queued requests may still hold
+            # handles into the multimodal cache, and clearing it invalidates
+            # those handles, which raises in the worker and kills the engine.
+            clear_cache = False
         if clear_cache:
             await self.renderer.clear_mm_cache_async()
         await self.engine_core.pause_scheduler_async(mode=mode, clear_cache=clear_cache)
